Licensing and contact

Status

commitwork is not published yet. The repository is private, there is no release, and no licence grant is in force. If you have been given a copy to look at, the only permission you have today is to evaluate it, and only against repositories you own or have been granted full access to — commitwork probes live targets on some lanes, and pointing it at a system you are not authorised to test is outside that permission.

The licence commitwork is intended to carry on publication, and the commercial terms that sit beside it, are settled but not yet in effect. They will be published with the repository. Until then this page states the status rather than restating terms that do not yet bind anyone.

Contact

Licensing, commercial use, and anything else: john@portll.net.

That is the address for a commercial conversation as well as a question. There is no form on this site and no sales pipeline behind it; it is one address, read by the person who wrote the tool.

Security disclosure

If you have found a defect in commitwork itself, write to the same address.
